newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: FORECAST-Petron 96 net seen slightly down.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Petron 96 net seen slightly down.

text.p: Philippine oil refiner Petron Corp is likely to record a slightly lower net profit in 1996 against the previous year, a Reuters poll conducted last week showed.
The respondents, from eight Manila brokerages, predicted Petron's 1996 net profit at an average of 3.965 billion pesos, a tad down from 1995's 4.0 billion pesos.
They said Petron's profits would be affected by an oil pricing formula which does not quickly transalate changes in world fuel prices into pump prices.
The analysts also predicted that 1997 net profits would rise to 4.588 billion pesos as the company benefited from full deregulation of the domestic oil industry and a cost-cutting programme.
Petron is to announce its full-year results late this month but no date has been set.
